hasSchema.headline: Common Care Questions
hasSchema.subheadline: Transparent answers regarding our methods, processing times, and handling policies.

items.question: How do you handle delicate silks and fragile weaves?
items.answer: We utilize specialized, low-stress cleaning solvents tailored specifically for delicate fibers to prevent snagging, shrinkage, or color bleed.

items.question: Can you guarantee the removal of old, set-in stains?
items.answer: While we cannot guarantee every set-in stain, our technicians have decades of experience executing tiered treatments to lift complex spots safely.

items.question: How long does specialized leather cleaning take?
items.answer: Leather and suede require distinct processing environments and careful conditioning. Please allow 7-10 days for professional restoration.

items.question: Is pickup and delivery available in the Castro area?
items.answer: Yes, we provide neighborhood-specific route pickups. You can coordinate scheduling by phone or dropping by our storefront.

items.answer: We partner with local Bay Area roasters who prioritize direct-trade relationships, paying premium wages to farmers, and encouraging sustainable farming practices.

hasSchema.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hasSchema.subtitle: Clear, practical information regarding our operational and clinical protocols.

items.question: How do you handle sudden dental emergencies?
items.answer: We reserve specific time slots daily for emergency triage. If you are experiencing acute pain or structural damage, please call us directly for priority scheduling.

items.question: What is included in a new patient examination?
items.answer: Your initial visit includes a comprehensive structural and periodontal evaluation, full-mouth digital x-rays if necessary, an oral cancer screening, and a detailed consultation regarding your long-term treatment plan.

items.question: Do you provide consultations for cosmetic work?
items.answer: Yes. We offer dedicated cosmetic assessments where we discuss your aesthetic goals, review imaging, and outline timeline and investment options for procedures like veneers or whitening.

items.question: Are you currently accepting new insurance networks?
items.answer: We are an established provider for most major PPO insurance plans. Our treatment coordinators will happily verify your specific coverage and explain benefits prior to any clinical procedure.
